local_sqlite_direct.reason: Normal app moves persist pending.json, not SQLite. Synced SQLite measures the upload/download roundtrip.

physical_pixels.reason: Framebuffer completion and display.update return do not establish physical panel scanout or visible pixels.

local_upload_ack_upper_bound.description: Local write → accepted Supabase RPC acknowledgement (commit upper bound)

local_sqlite_roundtrip.description: Local write → own UUID persisted in synced SQLite table (upload/download roundtrip)

local_confirmed_framebuffer.description: Local write → confirmed framebuffer draw complete

download_sqlite.description: Supabase commit → relevant SQLite table persisted

download_framebuffer.description: Supabase commit → relevant framebuffer draw complete

limits: The accepted Supabase RPC response is a commit acknowledgement upper bound, not a server commit timestamp.
Download latency is an interval from host request/response and clock probe bounds; it is not an exact point estimate.
Clock bounds assume both clocks are monotonic and obey the explicitly supplied drift limit; oscillator accuracy is not qualified.
Nearest-rank percentiles summarize observed samples; small samples do not establish tail reliability.

warmup_policy.annotations: capture.annotations joined by kind and sample_id; warmup:true rows also honored
warmup_policy.combination: Union of exclusions; a sample is never removed twice.

limits: Samples are transformed within their own capture clocks; only derived durations and intervals are pooled.
Display submission is not full panel transfer or visible-pixel timing.
Local Supabase persistence acknowledgement is a commit upper bound, not an exact server commit timestamp.
Download commit latency remains an interval; no midpoint is treated as an exact observation.
The explicit drift allowance is an engineering assumption; oscillator accuracy is not qualified.
These are instrumented, descriptive nearest-rank percentiles; small samples do not establish tail reliability.
Local feedback timings can include rejected/incomplete attempts when that endpoint was reached; upload acknowledgement requires acceptance.
